Iris (net-arch): follow-up to v2 controlplane RFC - proposing a low-risk cutover for private endpoints that avoids doubled egress and preserves src-ip for NAT customers.
Derek (infra): main ops ask: what guarantees can we give for source-IP continuity?
Iris (net-arch): not full guarantee for long-lived flows but we can provide a 3-minute grace affinity via signed affinity tokens. default: affinity_ttl=180s, configurable per-tenant.
Marta (onboarding): need per-tenant API toggle and a UI indicator. can we do migration_mode=auto|canary|hold?
Iris (net-arch): yes. server will advertise both v1/v2 during canary. switch to force after health window. fallback rule: if v2 auth fails 4x, pin to v1 for 10m and emit metric cp_v2_fallbacks.
Cal (eng-sre): metrics: cp_v2_attempts_total, cp_v2_fallbacks_total, cp_v2_handshake_ms_hist. alert if >0.6% tenants fallback over 10m. add probe metric for token refresh latency.
Noor (product): customers will ask about downtime and billing. doc line: "No expected downtime; brief IP continuity risk for persistent sessions; contact SE for strict ACLs."
Derek (infra): tokens are short-lived (6m). we need a tiny renewer binary for air-gapped installs or require relay-agent for cloud. renewer exposes /health and writes token to socket.
Marta (onboarding): CLI helpers: `rctl tenant migrate --id TID --mode canary|force|hold` plus `--dry-run` to simulate handshakes.
Iris (net-arch): migration steps:
```
1) set migration_mode=canary
2) deploy token-renewer or ensure relay-agent
3) dual-advertise with apex TTL=45s, duration=8m
4) monitor cp_v2_fallbacks and probe latency, then promote
```
deploy-bot: token-renewer v0.1 deployed to staging (sha: b7c9def)
Cal (eng-sre): runbook: pause rollout if fallback >0.6% for 10m; rollback = set hold + purge affinity cache.
Iris (net-arch): I'll draft the RFC addendum with a sequence diagram and affinity token spec. tagging owners for follow-ups.
